value.rationale: Survival of a complete birth cohort is a natural group-persistence statistic for simultaneous recruitment that cannot be recovered from leaf counts alone. Its sqrt(n) fluctuations persist while individual leaf variance shrinks to n/m, and the rare internal-recruitment count becomes Poisson exactly at batch size comparable to the number of rounds. The statement gives motivated structural dependence, explicit constants and a sharp regime boundary, rather than routine parameter substitution.
